metadata.purpose: Diagnostic flavor, not a product surface. Building with `--config tauri.conf.selfcheck.json` embeds this crate's frontend/index.html (the Rust/Axum channel + /node-operations self-check page) instead of the product React bundle, so the protocol can still be probed from a real WebView after the packaged default moved to ../dist. The page states "这不是产品 GUI"; tests/webview_assets.rs pins both halves.
